title: FalsifierResult
description: ADR 0006: the outcome of evaluating the feasibility_envelope.external_falsifier predicate over held-out data. Produced by research_harness/falsifier.py (a harness module), NOT by worker experiment code — produced_by is stamped by the harness and the attestation gate verifies it. A FalsifierResult with passed=true computed against the envelope-registered holdout is the ONLY path to user_goal_attestation.achieved=true.

kind.description: Mirrors the envelope's external_falsifier.kind. 'none' cannot produce a result (there is nothing to evaluate).

holdout_source_id.description: The held-out source the predicate was computed against. The attestation gate requires this to match feasibility_envelope.external_falsifier.holdout_source_id.

predicate.description: Echo of the envelope predicate that was evaluated (so the result is self-describing).

observed.description: The value the harness COMPUTED for predicate.metric over the holdout (e.g. measured Spearman rho). Not an LLM-asserted pass/fail — the boolean is derived from this number by the harness.

passed.description: Harness-derived: predicate(observed) is true. The worker cannot set this directly; it falls out of the deterministic comparison.

produced_by.description: Provenance stamp. The single allowed value marks this as harness-produced; the attestation gate rejects results not stamped here.

evidence.description: Kind-specific inputs the harness consumed. For cross_generator_transfer: ranking_a / ranking_b (held-out) vectors over the same pipeline set. For real_holdout: the metric reading and adapter provenance.
